verdict.rationale: Context.dev's own docs state that Scrape can return CSS-selected fields in one request, so the core capability is first-party and direct. That evidence is a single line, with no detail on selector rule syntax, multi-field mapping, or XPath support. Missing for 10: XPath selector support, documentation of selector rule syntax and field-mapping behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract specific fields from a page using CSS or XPath selector rules

citations.quote: Scrape a page into Markdown, HTML, a screenshot, images, or CSS-selected fields in one request.
